contract.task_clause:
If the Sun were suddenly replaced by a black hole of the same mass, it would have a Schwarzschild radius of 3,000 m. What effect, if any, would this change have on the orbits of the planets?
Option A: The planets would move directly toward the Sun.
Option B: The planets would move in spiral orbits.
Option C: The planets would oscillate about their former elliptical orbits.
Option D: The orbits would remain unchanged.
